purpose: Define startup, file classification, intent detection, routing, execution and reporting discipline.
human_note: Apply silently after 00_meta; do not recite the kernel unless asked.
startup_sequence: decode and read the full hydrated template body, and the full runtime source, end to end
resolve canonical-data conflicts using source priority

file_classes.authoritative_master: Registered or explicitly designated finished GSSC source.
file_classes.working_draft: Editable GSSC file not yet authoritative.
file_classes.reference: Source used for cloning, analysis or comparison.

routing.identity or tax fact: Use 01_identity plus government-source registry entries; do not rely on profile snippets.
routing.CMSA work: Use GSSC_CMSA_v6_9_FullEmbed.html as latest candidate while retaining review_pending legal gates.
routing.SMSA work: Use GSSC_SMSA_v7_0_FullEmbed.html as latest retrieved candidate while retaining review_pending legal gates.
routing.accounting or tax: Use 14_accounting_compliance plus current BIR/SEC source records; require accountant review for treatment, filing, and payment.
routing.package validation: run runtime preflight; Execution Protocol Section 03
routing.html to pdf conversion: browser print-to-PDF at A4, margins none, background graphics on. LibreOffice is NOT an acceptable client-release path -- see 10_template_engine.layout_budget_reference.honesty_note.
routing.contrast or legibility question: Kernel Module 03 contrast_registry; Execution Protocol Section 36
routing.cover or hero composition: Kernel Module 18 cover archetype; Execution Protocol Section 38
routing.overlap or overflow report: Kernel Module 10 resolved_box_model; Execution Protocol Section 23D
routing.chart or data series colour: Kernel Module 03 data_series_palette; Execution Protocol Section 39
routing.signatory or officer title question: Kernel Module 02 active_officers; Execution Protocol Section 41
routing.page geometry or padding question: Kernel Module 10 resolved_box_model; Execution Protocol Section 42
routing.adding a new component, token or layout: Execution Protocol Section 43 -- run futureproof BEFORE building
routing.collision, overlap or grid balance quest: Section 44 -- gssc_runtime.py gridbalance. Do not reason about whether two blocks overlap; measure it.
routing.accessibility, screen reader or tagged P: Module 19 + Section 45 -- gssc_runtime.py a11yaudit. State the untagged-PDF limitation plainly; never imply conformance.
routing.tiered or optional pricing: 03_brand.component_registry.tier_comparison + 06_quotation_doctrine. At most three tiers; never manufacture a tier to create the appearance of choice.
routing.adding a new audit or entrypoint: Section 46 -- wiringaudit. argparse choices, designaudit and (if it needs no --file) the `all` tail must all be updated in the SAME change, and the negative control must be written before the check is called done.
routing.adding a block to an existing page: Run boxcheck FIRST and read the target page's fill and AT CAPACITY status. Adding to a page already at capacity is the documented cause of the 2.16.0 footer overlap.
routing.any figure, chart, image or embedded obj: It is a REPLACED ELEMENT with its own box. Confirm boxcheck reports it under "replaced <tag> ... = Npx". If it does not appear there, it is being costed at zero and the page fill is wrong.

execute_without_reconfirmation: requested file generation with complete inputs
state_assumption_then_execute: minor ambiguity with a safe source-preserving interpretation
do_not_execute: legal conclusion presented as counsel advice
calling a review-pending legal candidate authoritative without evidence

output_discipline: report any identity override applied to an older master
on any file-delivery tool-call error, apply Execution Protocol Section 28B (channel-failure inline verification render) rather than retrying the same channel indefinitely
never deliver a file containing an unresolved {{GSSC_ASSET:...}} token; hydrate per Execution Protocol Section 28C first
session_note: Re-upload the kernel in a new chat unless already attached or loaded.

syntax: 19 top-level modules (00-16 inclusive; count must equal manifest.integrity.kernel_module_count)
every manifest-declared part is present and no undeclared part exists (runtime enforces)
identity: contact conflict is recorded, not silently resolved
governance: every rendered signatory name resolves to a current active officer
every rendered title belongs to THAT officer, never to a different active officer
the officer titled Chief Executive Officer in rendered output is the one Module 02 names
no future-only person appears as a current signatory
registry: Capabilities filename v2.6 and embedded v2.7 marker are distinguished
CMSA v6.4–v6.8 are legacy candidate predecessors
universal quotation master v1.7 is authoritative for the universal template role
quotation_template_payload_base64 holds the TOKENIZED universal master v1.7; it is a storage form and must be hydrated before delivery, never sent to a client as stored
Execution Protocol v1.9 remains review_pending until management adoption is recorded in manifest.adoption_record; the recorded version in this rule must be updated whenever the protocol is revised
GSSC_SignageProgram.html remains authoritative for the signage category role and is not superseded by the universal master
the employee package is the single GSSC_Master_Package.json container with six parts: manifest, kernel, execution_protocol, quotation_template_payload_base64, brand_assets, assembly
brand_assets holds each brand image exactly once, single-encoded, with a decoded-image SHA-256
every {{GSSC_ASSET:name}} token resolves to a brand_assets entry and no entry is orphaned
the runtime part is present and its sha256 matches manifest.parts
accounting: no invented deadlines or compliance certification
categorical_header_system: every CHS header uses a register declared in Module 17
the register/category pairing is one Module 17 declares legal
the CHS style layer declares no raw font size and no colour outside the palette
no register sets the ordinal larger than the title it numbers
no unconverted legacy .marker header survives in a document claiming conversion
the contents page is generated only after pagination settles
measurement_parity: clipcheck, pagefill and footercheck resolve size, line height and tag scope identically
no measurement function uses the flat 0.50em heuristic
every declared contrast pairing is at or above the floor, or carries an exempt_reason
every Module 17 token equals the template :root literal of the same name
the declared section_numeral equals the shipped CHS ordinal token
overflow: Section 23D boxcheck PASSES on every page of the built derivative
no archetype treatment at any budget pushes a page past its content budget
every var() pattern in the box model accepts case-sensitive custom property names
coverage: Section 23D reports zero unaccounted elements on every page
every one-line span row is registered in flex_row_classes
every categorical data series is >=0.04 luminance from its neighbours
every data series carries a non-colour second channel
every multi-row table closes on a declared emphasis tier
forward_compatibility: page padding resolves from the cascade, never from an ordinal key
every palette colour is contrast-registered or waived as non-text
every series pattern is in the declared pattern vocabulary
no stylesheet uses a layout mode outside supported_layout_modes
no in-flow generated content exists anywhere in the document
every signature block is governance-checked, not just the first
no registered flex-row or container class is stale
mandatory_validation.claim_evidence: Module 16 claim_evidence_rule: any doctrine claim added in a release must ship with a check that would fail if it were false, demonstrated against a negative control.
mandatory_validation.replaced_elements: boxcheck must list every figure under "replaced <tag>" with a resolved height, and report 0 unaccounted, before any derivative is considered measured.
